note: Turbopack honors the `debug` option (readable class names) like the webpack path, and keeps it apart in the production setup cache. A dev restart restores the previous session's sheet, class map and file map all together or not at all, so a missing or corrupt file no longer leaves a mix that gives new styles clashing names. When the import graph or file numbering cannot be built, Turbopack now prints a warning naming the cause and what the build loses instead of continuing silently. No new build errors
